positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionDecision
positions.frame: what does the decision to adopt Zypherion commit to for the analytics pipeline?
positions.why: Quinton's three statements — the adoption commitment (src-1), the performance justification (src-2), and the migration timeline (src-3) — cohere under a single read of what the Zypherion decision commits to. Xena's corresponding summaries (src-4, src-5, src-6) restate the same three facets from the recorder's footing, and the frame reads them cleanly: technology choice, performance rationale, and schedule.
